description: Change a reminder that exists: the date field, how many days before, the time, the time zone, who gets it, whether it repeats.

date_field.description: The date field's name or id

days_before.description: 0 = on the day, negative = after it

recipients.description: The whole list of email addresses; an empty list = the record's owner

repeat.description: every_day | every_week | every_month | every_year, or "" for once

name: update_reminder
